name: jaeger-idl
note: declaration corpus: four production .thrift IDLs (agent, jaeger, sampling, zipkincore) plus vendored thrift-gen Go (Thrift Compiler 0.19.0, modern generated-header marker). No namespace go and no namespace * in any IDL - scope falls back to file basename, which matches the generated package names.

name: jaeger-client-go
note: consumer corpus: archived repository (HEAD frozen), vendors thrift-gen stubs (Thrift Compiler 0.14.1) and real in-repo call sites (transport_udp.go, utils/udp_client.go, testutils/mock_agent.go). Sole HEAD-stable public repo found with stubs and call sites in one repository, which per-repo extraction requires for CALLS_OPERATION joins.

name: jaeger
note: cross-repo abstention showcase: imports jaeger-idl/thrift-gen stubs from another module, vendors none at HEAD, so the per-repo consumer index is empty and honest abstention is the expected outcome. Commit drifts with upstream HEAD; pinned here only for reproducible spike measurement.
